plugins.description: The Deliverd MCP server, three skills — approval (ask a person before a consequential action), ethics (put concerns about harm to a person in front of whoever decides) and artifact (build and publish an HTML page) — and three commands: /deliverd:publish, /deliverd:ask and /deliverd:status. One install.
